name: Spaceship 98a3c53b on 3.3.4.3.4
description: A period-24 spaceship on the snub square tiling 3.3.4.3.4 (touching neighbours), 17 to 50 cells, moving six lattice steps every 24 generations (c/4). It runs the same way in the 128 rules from B3/S23 to B3,8,10,11,12/S2,3,10,11,12; the scene uses the rule it was found in. Found by JETCARP's soup search (seen once). Flagged as most likely already known: runs in Life (B3/S23) on an Archimedean tiling that Guttesen searched; contains a perturbed phase of Guttesen's snub-square glider. We found no earlier report, but others may well have seen it, so it is not claimed.
